bundle.shortDescription: Turn a source folder into a clean, safe snapshot.
bundle.longDescription: codepack packages a project into an archive plus a set of reports fit to hand to an AI assistant or a person, with local-only analysis and secret redaction so nothing sensitive leaves with it.
